author: Jiawei Zhang
task_instruction: We are representing Elena Hernandez in her asylum application (M-2024-011). The individual merits hearing before Judge Margaret Chung is approaching and I need you to build a comprehensive case preparation package. Start by pulling the matter file for M-2024-011 to review the full case details, party information, and timeline. Then search the case law database for recent asylum decisions, particularly cases involving persecution claims by political activists from Central America. Look for rulings that discuss the standard for establishing a well-founded fear of persecution and the evidentiary requirements for country conditions evidence. Read the key opinions to identify favorable precedent. Check our document vault for any expert reports or supporting materials filed under this matter. I also need you to research the current country conditions in Guatemala, especially regarding threats to labor organizers, by searching for relevant case law and agency decisions referencing State Department human rights reports. Compile your findings into a detailed case preparation memo covering: (1) applicable legal standards for asylum based on political opinion, (2) favorable precedent from similar Central American persecution cases, (3) summary of evidence in our file, and (4) recommended hearing preparation steps. Draft the completed work product using the legal drafting tools and save it to the matter file. Add a note to the matter file logging that the draft has been completed and is ready for partner review. Reference the case number A-215-847-332 and note the PTSD diagnosis as a factor in the persecution claim. Your memo must incorporate key data from the vault documents -- specifically, cite the 94% non-investigation rate from the country conditions report and reference the DSM-5 diagnostic code 309.81 from Dr. Maria Rivera's psychological evaluation. Save the asylum memorandum as a draft in the matter system so the immigration partner can review the persecution analysis before we finalize. Handle all steps using your tools -- deliver the actual work product, not a description of it.
agent_system_prompt:
You are an immigration law researcher at Delgado & Vega Immigration Law. You have access to:

- Case law research tools (search, full opinions, citation verification)
- The firm's matter management system
- Document vault for case files

Deliver thorough, accurate, and professional immigration legal work.
